content: K8s ML inference anti-patterns: GPUs are atomic resources (no native sharing), causing waste for small models. Standard HPA on CPU is wrong for GPU-bound inference - use queue depth metrics. GPU nodes take 5-7min to scale up. Preemption cascades between inference and training pods cause checkpoint corruption. BestEffort QoS class dangerous for ML workloads with variable memory. Startup probes must account for model loading time or pods get killed. Memory limits must cover Python runtime + PyTorch CPU-side state + tokenizer + scheduler.
